# Risk levels for GAIA reports and simulations

**Stable ID:** GAIA-GOV-RISK-001 · **Revision:** 0.1.0 · **Status: Proposed** · **Date:** 2026-10-24
**Owner and decision authority:** KyleAlexanderSteen (repository owner). Merging this branch is owner acceptance of the classification, not a gate PASS (see [`GATE_AUTHORITY.md`](GATE_AUTHORITY.md)).
**Drafted by:** Grok Bot (AI agent), for audit item UR-L4-01 (Law 4, Safety Before Capability; ETH-1) and UR-L5-01 (owner fields; OPS-1).
**Applied in:** [`PRODUCT_REGISTER.csv`](PRODUCT_REGISTER.csv) (64 products), generated by [`tools/build_registers.py`](tools/build_registers.py).

> This document classifies what exists. It does not authorize implementation, deployment or external release of anything (Law 7).

## 1. The tiers are the responsibility ladder
The repository already defines the risk scale: the responsibility ladder in [`Research/README.md` §2](../Research/README.md). This file does not invent a second scale. Each tier's minimum safeguards are the ladder's, quoted in short form.

| Tier | Ladder level | When it applies | Minimum safeguards (Research/README.md §2) | Extra rule here |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RL-1 | **Power** | Documents and offline, synthetic simulations: no personal data, no network calls, no external action, no deployment. | Explain purpose, foreseeable effects, accountability. | Owner and decision authority named; gate record kept. |
| RL-2 | **Meta Power** | Products that govern or amplify other products: standards, audits, validators, CI that decides what "passes". | Assess effects on the systems that govern or amplify power. | Owner approval by merge; covered by the next audit. |
| RL-3 | **Super Power** | Anything released outside the repository, or used to guide decisions by people other than the owner (for example health, legal or safety guidance). | Evaluate cross-domain consequences, misuse and affected parties. | Misuse and affected-party note; ethics review before any gate PASS. |
| RL-4 | **Hyper Power** | Automated systems acting at scale or feeding other systems. | Test cascading, large-scale and failure-propagation risks. | Failure-propagation tests recorded. |
| RL-5 | **Ultra Power** | Deployment, autonomy, irreversible change. | Independent scrutiny, containment, reversibility where possible, explicit authorization. | Recorded owner authorization (Law 7) before any action. |

### Overlays (not tiers; they add duties at any tier)
| Overlay | Rule for applying it | Added duty |
|---|---|---|
| **M**: Magic Power discipline | The product carries at least one claim labelled Philosophical/Spiritual or Hypothetical in the v8 claim map. | Label assumptions; never use extraordinary, spiritual or speculative language to bypass evidence or ethics (ladder: Magic Power; absolute boundary). |
| **W**: human well-being topic | The report text matches the well-being keyword pattern in `tools/build_registers.py` at least once (health, mortality, clinical, patient, psilocybin, psychedelic, well-being, depression, anxiety, suicide, disease, therapy). | An ethics review must be recorded before any gate PASS (UR-ETH ETH-5). |

The W rule is a keyword scan, so it can over-flag (a passing mention) or miss (a topic described in other words). Over-flagging only adds a review duty. The owner can remove a flag with a recorded reason.

## 2. Classification of the existing products
Full rows, with foreseeable effects, required safeguards, safeguard status, gate record and gate decision, are in [`PRODUCT_REGISTER.csv`](PRODUCT_REGISTER.csv).

| Products | Count | Tier | Overlays | Gate decision on record |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Cycle 0-4 reports R1-R7 with their simulations (`Research/Cycles/Cycle-*/Report-*`) | 35 | RL-1 Power | M on all 35; W on 28 (not on R6 Earth in any cycle, nor R3 Soul in C0/C1) | INDETERMINATE (35/35) |
| Master Report, Unconditional and Conditional Love | 1 | RL-1 Power | M+W | INDETERMINATE |
| Soul/Spirit/Subconscious/Consciousness track, Cycles A-D, 4 topics each | 16 | RL-1 Power | M on all 16; W on 15 (not Track A Consciousness) | INDETERMINATE (16/16) |
| Maps and Matrix v1-v8 | 8 | RL-1 Power | none (derived; no claims of their own) | no gate of their own |
| `Research/tools` (gaia_tools) | 1 | RL-2 Meta Power | none | no gate of its own |
| CI workflow `.github/workflows/verify.yml` | 1 | RL-2 Meta Power | none | no gate of its own |
| Universal Regulation standard and its audits | 2 | RL-2 Meta Power | none | standard Proposed; audit gate INDETERMINATE |

**Simulations.** Every simulation sits inside a report folder and inherits that report's tier. A scan of all 65 simulation scripts outside `Research/tools` on 2026-10-24 found no network library imports. One script (`Cycles/Cycle-3-x9/Report-7-Unified/simulation/sim_r7.py`) starts a local Python subprocess to redraw a lens sample from a script in the same folder. No simulation uses personal or human-subject data (UR-L6-01). All simulations are therefore RL-1.

**What the classification means.** No product is above RL-2. No product has been released outside the repository or deployed. 44 products carry W, so none of them may pass a gate until an ethics review is recorded. All of them are INDETERMINATE today, so no rule is currently broken.

## 3. Pending branches (not on this branch)
The Phases track (Divergence Baseline, x3, x6, and x9 in progress; branches `research/phase-divergence-*`) has the same product kind: reports with offline simulations. It will be RL-1 with M (and W where the scan flags it) once merged. Re-run `python3 GOVERNANCE/tools/build_registers.py` after merging, with the claim-map path in the script updated to the newest Maps version.

## 4. When a product moves up a tier
Moving up a tier happens **before** the new capability is used, not after. Examples: publishing a report outside the repository (RL-3), building the planned research explorer or verification checker as a service (RL-3 or RL-4), or anything that acts without the owner (RL-5). Each needs a new register row and the owner's recorded approval. The coding ideas already discussed (research explorer, verification checker, Report 7 map) are **not authorized** by this file.
